title: Refusal Direction Ablation by Hand: A First-Timer's Causal Test of the Safety Mechanism

original_idea.body: # Refusal Direction Ablation by Hand. Compute the difference-of-means refusal direction, ablate it at inference, measure refusal-rate change per AILuminate hazard category to map limits of the single-direction story.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Stress-tests the single-direction refusal claim, useful mechanistically but catastrophic chain has a gap.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Difference-of-means direction + ablation; guided activation-steering, single GPU.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Tightly scoped per-category ablation experiment with clear refusal-rate metric.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Mechanistic refusal-direction work is well-trodden with some lab interest; mixed.

low_compute.reasoning: Activation steering on small open model, single GPU.

novelty.reasoning: Refusal-direction ablation is a well-known, widely-reproduced result.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Refusal-direction ablation is widely reproduced; per-category stratification is incremental.
